extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that adds native chromium pinch-to-zoom capabilities, allowing you to touchpad zoom as if you were using a browser.
problem: Users lack native browser-style pinch-to-zoom functionality when interacting with Obsidian on a touchpad.
summary: A plugin that adds native Chromium pinch-to-zoom capabilities, allowing users to zoom into and out of Obsidian notes using touchpad gestures.
